statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-0775 is ZDI's report ZDI-26-043 of a local privilege escalation in the npm CLI, described only as npm loading modules from an unsecured location, with no technical details or proof of concept published (https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-26-043/). ZDI's timeline records that npm called the reported behaviour by design. GitHub withdrew its advisory for this CVE (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3966-f6p6-2qr9) as a duplicate of the node-tar hard-link path traversal CVE-2026-24842, citing an npm maintainer's statement that this is not a vulnerability in npm itself and that npm extracts packages without links (https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/8939#issuecomment-3862719883). Debian lists it as unfixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-0775). Every published DHI npm package for Debian 13, 11.16.0-0 through 11.21.3-1, on amd64 and arm64, bundles node-tar 7.5.15 or later, above the 7.5.7 release that fixes CVE-2026-24842. Pending: the CVE record is not marked disputed and ZDI's report predates CVE-2026-24842, so whether the module-loading behaviour it describes applies to this package is not established.
